settings.acceptance: worse of the fused and separate binary64 evaluation routes, relative to F_0(x) at each node

precision_scope.evaluation: binary64, worse of the fused and separate multiply-add routes
precision_scope.count_unit: coefficients of one representation of the fit
precision_scope.why_fp64: the count trade is resolved at the double lane's 1e-13 F_0 contract; the nearest-neighbour comparison is 5e-14 absolute in binary64; and a binary64 coefficient is 8 bytes while a binary32 one is 4, so counts from the two lanes are not like-for-like storage
precision_scope.fp32_in_this_paper: static counts only, a secondary column; not part of the width law
precision_scope.sweep_scope: fp64 only: binary64 stored coefficients, binary64 evaluation, targets rel:1e-13 and abs:5e-14
precision_scope.fp32_comparison_would_need: the float lane's own path: fits stored and evaluated in binary32, both multiply-add routes, certified at max(2^-22 F_n(x), 1.5e-7) from the generator's f32 fit and acceptance functions, on the float lane's own edges and partitions

method.count_unit: (m + 1) numerator coefficients + k denominator coefficients, q_0 held at 1
method.certified: the smallest stored count at which some (m,k) pair with k <= 12 meets the target on the full 4,001-node grid; the count below it is settled by solving every pair there, not a coarse scan
method.batch: count_sweep.refine_pairs with its acceptance threshold set to infinity, so every solved pair's delivered error is returned; the ladder target is applied to the fits by count_sweep.meets
method.walk: start at the record's stored count minus one; if a pair meets there, walk down while the count below still has a meeting pair; otherwise check the record count and, if no pair meets, walk up to the first count that does
method.target_semantics: relative to F_0(x) at each node, the ladder's own reading

meta.provenance_note: boys git records the worktree HEAD when a fragment was written; the generator and header sha256 digests are the content identity and are carried per cell in content_identity

cell.why: flagged below_meets; excluded from the paper-width fit
cell.brief_count_note: the work order's count for this cell; for cells 1-5 it is the numerator degree m of the recorded pair, not (m+1)+k
cell.old_count_status: no_pair_meets (no pair at the record count meets)
